The [[Zygerria system/Legends|Zygerria system]] was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Chorlian sector/Legends|Chorlian sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]].
